items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: So, yeah, Dodd, I wrote a very early article too... Back in the twenties, he'd written... About jazz.

ctx.x: I tell you, I read that chapter, Consider the Critics. This is one of the first things I read when I picked up the book, because at that time, three, four years ago, I was very interested in how jazz, early jazz, or New Orleans jazz, got to be known nationally. And I had always thought that certain New Orleans musicians brought jazz to Chicago and then to New York, and it was popularized through people like Louie, etc. But then I began to realize that the New Orleans tradition was brought to the public attention…

So, yeah, Dodd, I wrote a very early article too, if I remember rightly. I don't know if it mentions it in there or anything. Back in the twenties, he'd written, I have in mind maybe 1927, as early as that. About jazz.
Is that right? No. It's funny because.
